summary: School urges FCC to preserve E-Rate funding for critical connectivity and affordability.

claims.argument: E-Rate funding has been a tremendous blessing to our school and students since the 1990s, enabling us to provide fast, reliable internet service through Spectrum. Without this funding, losing this support would mean that the additional costs would ultimately need to be passed on to our families, many of whom may not be able to afford higher tuition.
